text:
alex: Heads-up — noticed steady memory creep on a few long-chat nodes this morning. KV residency percentiles moving up while eviction_count doesn't match expected reclaim numbers. looks like reuse is falling off for >20k token sessions :thinking_face:

alex: quick log snippet from a repro run:```
2026-03-18T08:02:14Z node-12 kv_residency_p50=12 p90=78 p99=142 eviction_count=312 reclaim_ops=214
2026-03-18T08:12:14Z node-12 kv_residency_p50=14 p90=95 p99=210 eviction_count=320 reclaim_ops=216
```

mei: can you paste the query you used to compute those? want to compare against the live dashboard numbers.

alex: sure, i ran the sampler -> bigquery view we use for dashboards:```sql
SELECT bin, approx_quantiles(residency, 100)[OFFSET(90)] as p90, SUM(eviction_count) as evictions, SUM(reclaims) as reclaims
FROM `redwood-prod.kv_telemetry.session_samples`
WHERE sample_time BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
GROUP BY bin
ORDER BY bin
```

alex: numbers diverge from the dashboard by ~10-15% for evictions, hit-rate looks stable though.

jordan: any recent kernel selection or batching heuristic changes rolled to those nodes? could change access patterns and strip reuse from caches.

anita: pushed the micro-kernel PR (D472) last night but it was feature flagged off for canaries. nothing auto-enabled. batching heuristics PR (D469) did ship last week to canaries though.

mei: ok — so hypothesis 1 = sampler vs metrics TTL mismatch (we might be double-counting some sessions). hypothesis 2 = paging threshold tweak in D469 causing earlier fragmentation and less cross-request reuse.

alex: i instrumented a sample agent to emit per-slot lifecycle reasons. quick output:```
slot-chan[0] freed_by=eviction reason=age reuse_count=0
slot-chan[1] freed_by=reclaim reason=compact reuse_count=3
slot-chan[2] freed_by=eviction reason=fragmentation reuse_count=1
```

alex: fragmentation-related evictions are higher than before. paging churn looks correlated with sessions > 50k tokens.

jordan: can we add counters for eviction_reason (age|fragmentation|oom|policy) and eviction_latency bucketed? that would make dashboards actionable.

anita: agreed. also want to add residency percentiles (p50/p90/p99) per model+shard to spot hot partitions.

mei: propose small telemetry changes: 1) add eviction_reason tag, 2) emit per-eviction timestamps (to compute rate windows), 3) sample KV slot traces for 1% of long sessions.

alex: +1. for immediate triage i'm going to patch the sampler to surface reclaim_ops and eviction_reason. will also dump a heatmap of slot reuse for the last 24h.

anita: i'll schedule a quick dashboard mock in Grafana: panels = residency percentiles, eviction rate by reason, reuse distribution (CDF), eviction latency histogram, and a link to sample traces.

mei: can we add an alert: if eviction_rate_by_reason[fragmentation] > 0.5 * total_evictions for 10m OR p99_residency increases > 30% in 15m, alert eng-runtime on-call?

jordan: that alert sounds good. also add a maintenance-suppress window when we're running canaries or kernel rollouts.

sre-bot: [alert] kv-eviction-rate-fragmentation firing on node-12 (312 events, 12m) :rotating_light:

alex: noted. i'm attaching the short trace from node-12 to the dashboard (link: https://grafana.internal/d/kv/residency-heatmap?orgId=1).

mei: next steps/action items:
- alex: push sampler patch (eviction_reason + reclaim_ops) and run against canaries (ETA 2h)
- anita: dashboard mock + alert rule PR (ETA end of day)
- jordan: add maintenance suppress logic to alerting (ETA tomorrow)
- mei: run a one-hour comparative job between sampler counters and dashboard aggregates to find discrepancy root (ETA 4h)

alex: i'll post back with the reclaimed vs eviction delta once the patch runs. thanks all :thumbsup:

jordan: heads-up for anyone following: keep long-session load at medium until we validate — try to avoid heavy >100k token tests for the next 8h.

mei: tagging @anita and @alex for follow-up reminders. :eyes:
